source_research: MDPI Information (Jan 2026): Uncertainty-aware forecasting with ECE/MCE calibration metrics
Preprints.org (May 2025): XGBoost SHAP — away_win_streak top predictor
MDPI Computation (Oct 2025): Win streak before game = #1 SHAP feature
Medium/Jesse Fu: Away win streaks outperform overall streaks in prediction
motivation: Current Cat5 tracks overall W/L streak but NOT venue-specific streaks. 2025-2026 research consistently identifies AWAY win streak as the top or near-top SHAP feature in NBA prediction models. Our engine uses the same streak value regardless of venue context. Additionally, Jan 2026 paper shows ECE/MCE calibration uncertainty as a novel meta-feature improving Brier score — we have calibration tracking (Cat20) but not ECE/MCE as explicit features.
